title: OBI Skill Contract
description: Base contract every skill's manifest.yaml must satisfy.

id.description: Unique kebab-case skill id, matches folder name (e.g. 'idea-analysis')

depends_on.description: Skill ids this skill expects as prior artifacts (e.g. market-research depends_on idea-analysis)

input_schema.description: Relative path to this skill's input JSON schema (e.g. 'schema.json#/input')

output_schema.description: Relative path to this skill's output JSON schema (e.g. 'schema.json#/output')

artifacts.description: Files this skill must produce, e.g. ['report.md', 'data.json', 'sources.json']

provider_requirements.description: Declares whether this skill needs an LLM Provider Interface and/or a Research Interface, without naming a specific vendor
